This will create a compressed archive of your Termux data directory (installed packages and environment together with your home directory).\n\nChoose a destination file to save the backup.

Restoring will OVERWRITE the current Termux data directory (installed packages plus your home directory) with the contents of the selected backup file. Existing data will be LOST.

⚠ If the restore fails — because the backup file is corrupted, incomplete, or the connection is interrupted during the process — your Termux environment will be LEFT EMPTY. There will be no way to recover the original data.

This cannot be undone. It is strongly recommended to back up FIRST and verify the backup file is valid.
